title: Physics-Informed Method of Group Data Handling: Adaptive Construction of Functional Representations with an Application to the Navier-Stokes Equations
abstract: arXiv:2609.39291v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed computational methods usually optimize parameters within a functional representation whose structure is fixed in advance. This work proposes a Physics-Informed Method of Group Data Handling (PI-GMDH), in which representations of coupled physical fields are progressively constructed during solution. Candidate functional directions are evaluated through the first variation of the complete physical and observational objective, introduced in packages, and followed by block-coordinate damped Gauss-Newton coefficient optimization. The framework is demonstrated with tensor-product Chebyshev functions on the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations using a two-dimensional time-dependent Taylor-Green benchmark. Under the tested configuration, adaptive PI-GMDH reached validation and held-out test losses of 5.299e-19 and 5.296e-19 with 204, 201, and 175 active functions for u, v, and p. Complete degree-by-degree and all-terms PI-GMDH

translated_title: 物理信息群数据处理方法：函数表示的自适应构造及其在纳维-斯托克斯方程中的应用
translated_abstract: 物理信息计算方法通常在结构预先固定的函数表示内优化参数。本工作提出了一种物理信息群数据处理方法，其中耦合物理场的表示在求解过程中逐步构造。候选函数方向通过完整的物理与观测目标的一阶变分进行评估，以包的形式引入，随后进行块坐标阻尼高斯-牛顿系数优化。该框架以张量积切比雪夫函数在不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程上进行了演示，并使用二维时间依赖的泰勒-格林基准问题进行测试。在所测试的配置下，自适应PI-GMDH达到了5.299e-19和5.296e-19的验证损失与留出测试损失，u、v和p三个场分别使用了204、201和175个活跃函数。完整的逐次和全项PI-GMDH
tldr: 提出物理信息群数据处理方法PI-GMDH，在求解过程中自适应构造耦合物理场的函数表示，通过完整物理与观测目标的一阶变分评估候选函数方向，在不可压缩纳维-斯托克斯方程上达到了接近机器精度的求解精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PI-GMDH, a physics-informed method that adaptively constructs functional representations of coupled physical fields during solution by evaluating candidate directions through the first variation of the complete physical and observational objective, achieving near machine-precision accuracy on the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.
